description: Create a new task in a List, setting any fields you provide (description, status, priority, dates, assignees, tags, custom fields, parent for subtasks). Returns the created task with its id.

assignees.description: Full set of assignee user ids. On update this REPLACES the current assignees (use assignees_add/assignees_rem for incremental changes).

custom_fields.description: Array of custom field assignments as { id, value } objects.

value.description: Value in the shape required by the field's type.

custom_item_id.description: Custom task type id (from `get_custom_task_types`); null for the default Task type.

custom_task_ids.description: Set true to treat `task_id` as a custom task ID instead of a native ClickUp ID. Requires `team_id`.

due_date.description: Due date (natural language, ISO, or epoch ms).

due_date_time.description: If true, the due date includes a specific time of day.

list_id.description: ID of the List to create the task in.

markdown_content.description: Markdown task description. Takes precedence over `description` if both are given.

parent.description: Parent task id; set to make this task a subtask of that parent.

start_date.description: Start date (natural language, ISO, or epoch ms).

start_date_time.description: If true, the start date includes a specific time of day.

status.description: Status name (must exist in the task's List, e.g. 'to do', 'in progress', 'complete').

tags.description: Tag names to set on the task (must already exist in the Space).

team_id.description: Team/Workspace ID. Falls back to CLICKUP_TEAM_ID when omitted.

name: create_task
